summary: Iter 2 testing complete. 27/27 backend pytest tests pass (16 new + 11 regression from iter 1). Verified Settings auth gating (401 no-auth, 403 member, 200 admin), GET/PUT /api/settings with email lowercase+trim+dedup persistence, GET /api/users admin-only, PATCH /api/orders/{id}/reassign for both artists and status with 401/404 paths, reminder_loop startup log, and sent_reminders dedup via unique _id. Frontend Playwright verified: nav-settings visible only for admin, hidden for member; Board view-mode toggle (per Artist=3 cols, per Status=6 cols Modeling/Rigging/Texturing/Rendering/Delivery/Done); cards have draggable=true (8 cards). Settings page UI fully functional — add/save/reload/remove email whitelist persists end-to-end via PUT /api/settings. Member visiting /settings correctly shows 'Akses ditolak' guard. Drag-and-drop dispatch not simulated via Playwright (HTML5 native DnD is unreliable in headless); the underlying PATCH endpoint is fully verified by API tests, and the UI elements (draggable=true, columns, view toggle) all render correctly.

minor.issue: Legacy users created before iter2 (e.g. magsikastudio@gmail.com from earlier OAuth login) have no 'role' field at all. Projection {role:1} returns no role key for them, so frontend treats them as undefined role (neither admin nor member). They will only get a role on next login. Recommend a one-line migration: db.users.updateMany({role:{$exists:false}},{$set:{role:'member'}}) plus promote that single legacy user to admin if desired.

issues: When a member navigates directly to /settings, Settings.jsx fires GET /settings and GET /users immediately in useEffect before the role-gate renders. This produces a transient red toast 'Gagal memuat settings: Admin only' even though the page then correctly shows the 'Akses ditolak' card. Fix: short-circuit the useEffect when user?.role !== 'admin' (return early before the api.get calls).
WebSocket initial connect logs 'WebSocket is closed before the connection is established' warning before stabilising — pre-existing from iter 1, not user-visible.

action_items: Optional: short-circuit Settings.jsx useEffect when user.role !== 'admin' to avoid spurious error toast for members landing on /settings directly.
Optional: add a small migration on startup to backfill role='member' for users where role is missing, so /api/users returns a consistent shape.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/auth/session bootstrap (line 178-186): only the very first user (when has_admin is false) becomes admin. If you delete the admin user later, the next login becomes admin too — fine for this app. But there's a pre-existing legacy user without a role field; they don't count as admin, so the next OAuth login on this preview env would auto-promote that new user to admin. Acceptable for an internal admin tool.

server.py PATCH /orders/{id}/reassign is gated only by get_current_user (any authenticated member can reassign artists/status). Iter 2 spec doesn't restrict it to admin — confirmed intent: members can drag cards. If later you want admin-only reassign, swap dependency to require_admin.

server.py reminder_loop uses datetime.fromisoformat(o['deadline']) where deadline is YYYY-MM-DD; .replace(tzinfo=UTC) then .replace(hour=23,minute=59) — fine but seconds=0 means a deadline ending at 23:59:00 — minor.
server.py send_fonnte uses blocking requests inside an asyncio task — should use httpx.AsyncClient for non-blocking. Low priority since loop only runs every 10 min.
server.py PUT /api/settings: payload dedup is correct (lowercased+stripped) but does not preserve order; returned list may be in arbitrary order. Frontend doesn't depend on order so OK.
Frontend Settings.jsx: the role check happens after useEffect fires the API call (see design_issues above).
test_credentials: OAuth-based; sessions seeded directly in mongo test_database. /app/memory/test_credentials.md and /app/auth_testing.md describe the seeding flow. All test users + sessions cleaned up after testing.
seed_data_creation: Created 4 test users (admin+member for backend pytest, admin+member for frontend Playwright). All cleaned up post-test. 12 sample orders remain intact. One legacy user 'magsikastudio@gmail.com' (no role field) exists from pre-iter2 OAuth — kept untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 2 features all working end-to-end. Backend tests: /app/backend/tests/test_iter2.py (16 tests) + /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (11 tests, iter 1 regression) — all pass. To test admin/member: seed user with role='admin' or 'member' in users collection plus a session in user_sessions; cookie or Bearer header both work. PATCH /api/orders/{id}/reassign accepts {artists:[...]} and/or {status:'...'} and broadcasts order.updated WS event. Settings doc is single _id='global'. sent_reminders uses _id-based dedup. The Fonnte send path is not exercised in tests (token blank); send_fonnte returns False on empty token/target as expected.
rca of the issue: n/a — all features pass. The single noted minor (member sees transient error toast on /settings) is a UX detail caused by useEffect firing before the role-gate render; trivial 2-line fix.
